fixture_transcript: There's a serious backlog in front of the shrink-wrap station, totes are piled up three deep waiting for it to catch up.
Same thing an hour later, still a queue building up in front of shrink-wrap, hasn't cleared since this morning.

fixture_caption.scene_description: Pallets of totes queued up directly in front of the shrink-wrap machine, stacked higher than the machine itself.

fixture_transcript: Shrink-wrap machine went down for a changeover for almost twenty minutes right in the middle of the backlog, operators said they didn't have the next roll staged ahead of time.
Another shrink-wrap stoppage, waiting on a part -- a replacement roll of film that wasn't staged nearby, probably ten minutes lost.
Meanwhile the labeling station upstream is running ahead, building a stack of labeled totes that shrink-wrap can't keep up with, so they're just sitting there taking up floor space.
Same thing at the case-pack step before that, running well ahead, building excess wip upstream that's just going to sit until shrink-wrap clears.
Supervisor mentioned they've talked about adding a second shrink-wrap machine before the holiday peak but it hasn't been approved yet.
One of the leads floated wanting to cross-train a picker to help run a second shrink-wrap head when volume spikes, but nobody's been trained yet.

Talked to the shift lead, they said last month the real slow point was actually the case-erector -- used to be the bottleneck there -- but that's caught up now and shrink-wrap is the one falling behind.
Walked the receiving end of this line just to check, no backlog there, that part's running fine.

fixture_caption.scene_description: Empty conveyor section between the label station and shrink-wrap, no product moving through, consistent with operators' reports of waiting on shrink-wrap.

fixture_transcript: No safety issues to report on this walk, just the flow issue at shrink-wrap.
Quick note: inventory count near shrink-wrap looked accurate, no discrepancy there.
Followed up at end of shift, the queue in front of shrink-wrap was still four totes deep, hadn't cleared by end of day.

fixture_caption.scene_description: End-of-shift photo showing totes still queued at the shrink-wrap infeed.
